summary: Targeted improvement pass before end_model. Key findings: (1) h=14 raw-units LightGBM dramatically beats prior champion (28.865 vs 34.891 on fold-3 nz val) and beats floor on all 3 folds. (2) h=7 Optuna champion verified robustly across all 3 folds. (3) h=90 lgbm_A_no_anc confirmed on multi-fold (pooled 40.796 vs pooled floor 59.165) — prior 4-row result was genuine, not noise. (4) h=60 ML model (Optuna) beats floor on non-zero val rows all 3 folds, but floor values here are much higher than baseline (60.773 vs 40.042) due to non-zero row filtering — end_model MUST reconcile using consistent all-rows evaluation before declaring h=60 champion.

h7.multifold_config: Optuna params: n_estimators=522, lr=0.006877, num_leaves=57, max_depth=4, ratio_h7 target
h7.note: Champion robust across all folds. Fold-3 primary MAE=31.188 vs fold-3 floor=34.125. Baseline floor 31.263 computed differently (all rows); end_model must use consistent row selection.

h90.note: Prior config (n_leaves=16, lr=0.05, n_trees=68) wins over fresh Optuna (worse pooled). Floor values are on non-zero val rows per fold; end_model must reconcile with baseline floor (42.143, all rows pooled 3 folds).

h60.warning: Floor of 60.773 on non-zero rows MUCH higher than baseline floor 40.042 on all rows. The 2 excluded zero-demand val rows appear to be easy predictions for the naive predictor (near-zero error), inflating the nz-only floor. End_model MUST evaluate h=60 on ALL fold-3 val rows (same as baseline) before declaring ML beats floor.

handoff.read_this_first: h=14 has a new champion: raw-units LightGBM (28.865 fold-3, beats floor on all 3 folds). h=7 and h=90 confirmed. h=60 ML beats floor on non-zero rows but end_model MUST re-evaluate h=60 on all val rows against the 40.042 baseline before declaring champion.

h14_champion_model.why: Raw-units target, inner-split refit (last 20% of fold-3 train as inner val). Config: n_leaves=16, lr=0.03, n_trees=292. Must refit on train+val in end_model.

h14_feature_set.value: FEAT_RAW: all numeric cols excluding targets, ratio cols, anchor cols, fold/split markers
h14_feature_set.why: Raw-units model does not use ratio_h14 or anchor columns.

h14_config.why: Pinned from inner-fold early stopping — cannot re-derive once val rows are in refit.

h90_champion_model.why: lgbm_A_no_anc, n_leaves=16, lr=0.05, n_trees=68, inner-split. Multi-fold confirmed.

h90_config.why: Pinned from inner-fold early stopping across multi-fold check.

durable_rules.rule: h=14 champion uses RAW UNITS target (bread_quantity_h14), NOT ratio_h14. Feature set excludes ratio and anchor columns. Refit must use FEAT_RAW.
durable_rules.why: Raw-units target outperformed ratio target (28.865 vs 30.116) on fold-3, and outperformed on all 3 folds. The anchor for h=14 is same-DOW (DOW shift=0) but ratio compression did not help.
durable_rules.cost_if_broken: Shipping the ratio model which is 1.3 MAE units worse, or the wrong feature set.

durable_rules.rule: h=60: evaluate on ALL val rows (including zero-demand days) against baseline floor 40.042. Do NOT use non-zero-only evaluation to declare h=60 beats floor.
durable_rules.why: Non-zero-only floor for h=60 is 60.773 (much higher than baseline 40.042) because the 2 excluded zero-demand rows have near-zero error for the naive predictor. The comparison is only valid against the full-row baseline.
durable_rules.cost_if_broken: Incorrectly declaring h=60 ML beats baseline floor when it may not.

durable_rules.rule: h=90: Use pooled multi-fold MAE for champion declaration, not fold-3 alone (only 4 rows in fold-3).
durable_rules.why: 4 fold-3 val rows is statistically unreliable; multi-fold (129 rows) gives reliable estimate.
durable_rules.cost_if_broken: Selecting h=90 champion based on noise.

methodological_cautions.caution: h=60 floor values computed on non-zero val rows are much higher than the baseline floor computed on all val rows. The two metrics are NOT interchangeable.
methodological_cautions.why: Zero-demand val days (closed days) are easy for the naive predictor if it correctly predicts near-zero, lowering the all-rows floor. Excluding them inflates the apparent floor.
methodological_cautions.cost_if_ignored: Declaring h=60 ML beats floor on non-zero rows, but the actual baseline comparison (all rows) might show the ML does NOT beat the 40.042 baseline.

do_not_repeat.tried: Ratio target for h=14 (ratio_h14 = bread_quantity_h14 / naive_h14_seasonal_median_w4)
do_not_repeat.evidence: fold-3 ratio=30.116 vs raw=28.865; pooled ratio=27.576 vs raw=25.747
do_not_repeat.why_not_again: For h=14 (DOW shift=0), raw units outperforms ratio consistently across all 3 folds.
do_not_repeat.reopen_if: FE produces a more accurate anchor column for h=14.

content_carried_forward.h14_winner: raw_units LightGBM: n_leaves=16, lr=0.03, n_trees=292, max_depth=5, reg_alpha=1.0, reg_lambda=10.0
content_carried_forward.h60_action: end_model must evaluate h=60 on all val rows to determine if ML beats 40.042 baseline
